label: 샘방울 칼날 + 갑각
method: Complete coherent image-generated full-body cels. Whole source-cell cropping and integer registration only. No alpha cleanup, warping, resampling, part composition, rotation, or interpolated anatomy in deliverable sheets. The last cel in return-to-neutral actions repeats the whole first cel exactly. Birth is a complete authored scene including nest, water-neck, travel and landing, not a code-composed scene.
limitations: 16 source key cels per action, rather than 60fps independently drawn frames.
Faithful generated interpretation of existing concept, not pixel-identical concept art.
Transparent generated source has extremely faint edge alpha; native alpha is preserved unchanged.
Birth contains the nest and complete world travel, and is a planning-scene clip rather than a body-only runtime sprite.

qa.visualResult: All 96 cels inspected on both dark and light contact sheets. Armor rim and attached blade remain one coherent body in active poses. No feet, limbs, ranged projectiles or visible edge clipping. Birth visibly originates from the nest and lands; death loses its eyes and crest into a still puddle.
